_about: Read-only exports for FEAT-PLAYBOOK-001 B8 and B11, taken 2026-11-16 with ./scripts/db_query_cr.sh -q (no --commit; every statement rolled back). Each *_bars.csv is the execution's result_NNN.csv byte for byte. Each .json and .json.gz is that statement's entry of the execution's results.json as {columns, rows} (the CSV export writes JSONB columns as Python repr); .json.gz is gzip of the same JSON with mtime 0. rows counts data rows. sha256 is of the committed file.

SPY_bars.csv.sql: SELECT ts, open, high, low, close, volume, inserted_at FROM market_data_intraday WHERE ticker = 'SPY' AND interval = '1min' AND ts >= '2026-11-16 09:00:00+00' AND ts < '2026-11-16 14:30:00+00' ORDER BY ts

QQQ_bars.csv.sql: SELECT ts, open, high, low, close, volume, inserted_at FROM market_data_intraday WHERE ticker = 'QQQ' AND interval = '1min' AND ts >= '2026-11-16 09:00:00+00' AND ts < '2026-11-16 14:30:00+00' ORDER BY ts

brief_rows.json.sql: SELECT ticker, analysis_ts, run_kind, rvol, ftfc_score, ftfc_labels, level_basis FROM premarket_analysis WHERE analysis_date = '2026-11-16' AND run_kind = 'live' AND ticker IN ('SPY','QQQ','IWM') ORDER BY ticker

daily_rows.json.sql: SELECT ticker, date, open, high, low, close, volume, atr_14, atr_5, atr_20, pre_high, pre_low, pre_vwap, pre_volume, gap_pct, pre_range_atr, pre_fetched_at, pre_excluded_stale_prints, pre_excluded_spikes, pre_filter_status, pre_filter_params FROM market_data_daily WHERE ticker IN ('SPY','QQQ','IWM') AND date IN ('2026-11-13','2026-11-16') ORDER BY ticker, date

iwm_daily_volumes.json.sql: SELECT date, volume FROM market_data_daily WHERE ticker = 'IWM' AND date <= '2026-11-13' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 21

level_params.json.sql: SELECT 'policy' AS row_kind, NULL AS ticker, p.param_key, NULL AS value, NULL AS status, NULL AS atr_basis, p.method_id, p.statistic_q, p.lookback_sessions, p.min_sample, p.extra, p.effective_from, NULL AS policy_effective_from, NULL AS sample_n, NULL AS input_from, NULL AS input_to, NULL AS run_id, NULL AS source FROM level_param_policy p WHERE p.effective_from <= '2026-11-16' UNION ALL SELECT 'ticker' AS row_kind, t.ticker, t.param_key, t.value, t.status, t.atr_basis, t.method_id, NULL AS statistic_q, NULL AS lookback_sessions, NULL AS min_sample, NULL AS extra, t.effective_from, t.policy_effective_from, t.sample_n, t.input_from, t.input_to, t.run_id, t.source FROM (SELECT tp.ticker, tp.param_key, tp.value, tp.status, tp.atr_basis, tp.method_id, tp.effective_from, tp.policy_effective_from, tp.sample_n, tp.input_from, tp.input_to, tp.run_id, tp.source, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY tp.ticker, tp.param_key, tp.atr_basis ORDER BY tp.effective_from DESC) AS rn FROM ticker_level_params tp WHERE tp.ticker IN ('SPY','QQQ','IWM') AND tp.effective_from <= '2026-11-16') t WHERE t.rn = 1
